reason: The row's trigger ('DSV completed the acquisition of DB Schenker') is real but dated 30 April 2025: DSV company announcement 1154 confirms completion of the Schenker acquisition from Deutsche Bahn for approx. DKK 106.7bn (EUR 14.3bn) on that day, with Jens H. Lund quoted as Group CEO. That is 14 months before the row's date of 4 July 2026, far outside the 90-day trigger window. No fresh capital or identity inflection was found inside the window: DSV's June-July 2026 news is a Hillsboro, Oregon contract-logistics groundbreaking (17 Jun 2026), the H1 2026 results call notice (23 Jun 2026) and the H1 report itself (22 Jul 2026, after the row's date), all routine. Two further reasons not to build: DSV already runs a motorsport logistics sponsorship (Official Logistics Partner of Porsche Motorsport North America for 2026, announced Feb 2026, relationship since Aug 2023), so the 'no motorsport' framing of the thin row is wrong; and the F1 logistics lane is held at championship level by DHL (Official Logistics Partner since 2004) with Ceva Logistics on the Ferrari roster and DP World on McLaren's, so 'category whitespace' does not survive the sponsor table either. Re-open only on a new DSV-originated catalyst (a further transaction, a US listing, or a stated brand-building programme).
